notes:
- **Fixed: an Outlook or Microsoft 365 inbox could stop being read and never start again.** Your
  agent then saw none of the email that came in and could not draft a single reply. After this
  update it reads new email as it arrives, with nothing for you to reconnect. Email that came in
  while it was stuck is still in your inbox, but your agent does not go back and read it.
- **When Archie cannot read your email or your texts, your agent tells you in your chat.** If it
  has not been able to read them for more than half an hour, you get one message saying so and
  what to do, or that there is nothing for you to do, and another when it works again. It only
  tells you to reconnect an account when the sign-in is really what stopped working.
- **Your to-do list is the first card on the Dashboard**, unless something is waiting for you. It
  shows every open task. Tick one off (there is an undo), or type a new one straight into it.
- **Records are called Lists now, and Knowledge opens like folders.** Documents, Lists, Memory and
  How you write each say under their name whether your agent only reads them or keeps them up to
  date. A document sits in the folder for its kind.
- **Your agent never presses a button that sends money or signs something on a website**, even
  when you tap yes. That last press is always yours.
- **Reset also disconnects every phone** and empties anything that was waiting to reach one.
